O custo da governança é estimado opção p: The cost of governance is estimated option by option, with explicit calculations and public parameters, and split into investment (CapEx) and operations (OpEx). This page explains the calculation in two parts: first in plain language, with a fictitious example worked out step by step; then the complete technical model, with the notation, the equations, the parameters and the sources.
A maior parte do custo da governança é t: Most of the cost of governance is people's work: those who draft a regulation, supervise the use of AI or coordinate a committee. The calculation therefore starts from a simple question: how much it costs, per month, to have each person needed working on the topic, and how many months of work each option requires. In the data, infrastructure and technological independence options, what is purchased, such as storage, virtual machines and the sovereign cloud, is also included, counted by consumption and at public prices.
Cada opção escolhida no plano tem a sua: Each option chosen in the plan has its own calculation. The sum of the options is the direct cost, and three costs that every public project has are added to it: travel and in-person activities, the institution's indirect costs and the fee of whoever administers the funds. Finally, each amount is split into investment, which creates something that lasts beyond the plan, and operations. The figure shows this path, from the total down to the source data.
Dois tipos de opção têm contas mais dire: Two types of option have more direct calculations, in which the quantity is entered by whoever prepares the plan. Full-time staff is the number of people times the monthly cost times the plan's duration. Training is the number of participants times the hours times the hourly cost, estimated at US$ 12 per participant-hour and replaceable by the contract amount.
Formação de {participantes} servidores p: Training of {participantes} civil servants for {horas} hours: {participantes} × {horas} × US$ 12 = {formacao}.
As opções de dados, infraestrutura e ind: The data, infrastructure and technological independence options add, when there is people's work, a reference team and, beyond it, the parts that are purchased: storage, virtual machines, backup copies, licences and equipment. Cloud consumption is counted by volume, using the public price list of a major provider (storing 1 GB for a month costs about US$ 0.02), and what depends on the supplier, such as network links, commercial licences and equipment, is entered as an informed amount.
A interoperabilidade e a plataforma comu: Interoperability and the common data exchange platform follow the official X-Road cost calculators, the platform used by Estonia and other countries: 655 working days to deploy the central platform, 44 days to connect each system, and the annual costs of servers and certificates.
A nuvem soberana tem um modelo próprio,: The sovereign cloud has its own model, per 100,000 inhabitants, with two paths. If the government builds the infrastructure, there is a minimum investment, which exists even in small countries, plus a part proportional to the population, adjusted by the country's IMF income group and by the government's digital maturity, measured by the World Bank's GovTech index; operations add facility maintenance and the platform team. If the government contracts a provider, it pays each year the cost equivalent to building, with the investment spread over the useful life and the price premium of sovereign cloud over regular cloud, and invests only in migration. Since the cloud serves the whole government, education accounts for its share, which is education spending in total government spending and can be changed in the plan.

As viagens incidem só sobre o trabalho d: Travel applies only to people's work, and indirect costs to that work plus travel; purchases of infrastructure, equipment, licences and cloud services are excluded from both bases, as in the sources, which exclude the purchase of products (Global Fund) and equipment and capital expenditures (United States government). The fee applies to the whole direct cost plus travel. Each has a question in the plan: if there are no in-person activities, if the institution already covers indirect costs or if the agency itself executes the funds, the corresponding percentage is zero.
Cada parte de cada opção é investimento: Each part of each option is investment (CapEx) or operations (OpEx), under a simple accounting rule. Investment is the purchase of assets, such as equipment and the infrastructure of an own cloud, and the deployment of systems, platforms, integrations and migrations, which create something that lasts beyond the plan. Everything else is operations: the work on regulations, guidelines, supervision, training and staff, cloud consumption, licences and contracted services. Additional costs are split between the two in proportion to their base.
No exemplo, só os equipamentos de rede s: In the example, only the network equipment is investment ({equip}). The administrative fee is split in proportion to the direct cost, which gives {TK} of investment, and travel and indirect costs, which apply only to people's work, are operations. Investment: {equip} + {TK} = {K}; operations: {C} − {K} = {X}.
O custo do plano mede todo o trabalho ne: The plan cost measures all the work needed, including that of people who are already civil servants. To know how much new money will be needed, whoever prepares the plan marks, in each team, the roles already filled by civil servants. The tool then shows the new outlay, which is the plan cost without the work of these civil servants. In any team, roles can also be added, with profile, people, time allocation and monthly cost, which enter the same calculation.
O modelo é determinístico e paramétrico:: The model is deterministic and parametric: each cost line is the product of quantities, defined by the reference team or entered in the plan, and unit prices obtained from official statistics or public sources, and additional costs are percentages of bases defined from the lines. Each line is classified as investment (CapEx) or operations (OpEx), and all amounts are rounded to the cent on each line. Os preços de nuvem estão em dólares e sã: Cloud prices are in dollars and converted at the day's exchange rate; X-Road prices are in euros and converted at the euro rate. The virtual machine price is the median of the provider's 68 regions, because prices vary from region to region.
Na nuvem soberana, a população e o gasto: For the sovereign cloud, population and education spending come from the World Bank and can be changed in the plan; a country without a CGSI receives the median of its IMF group, and, with no country chosen, the emerging market and middle-income group applies.
As 31 equipes têm de 2 a 8 pessoas; as o: The 31 teams have 2 to 8 people; one-off options last 2 to 12 months and ongoing options the whole plan. Each role appears with its occupational group (G1 to G4) and with people × time allocation; the asterisk marks the specialist premium. The supervision unit sits at the lower end of the range estimated by the European Commission for the AI Act (1 to 25 full-time civil servants per country), and the sandbox follows the pace of the Norwegian sandbox (four projects per year, three to six months each).
O modelo da nuvem soberana é preliminar: The sovereign cloud model is preliminary (grade C): there are few public cases of government investment in cloud or data centres, and they differ in scope. In the eight cases used, the model falls between half and four and a half times the observed value, and tends to overestimate projects that are only one phase of a larger programme (such as the first of Indonesia's four data centres). The coefficients should be recalibrated when more sourced cases are available, and lower-income groups are not given a lower cost, because the cases do not show this.
Os preços de nuvem são os de um grande p: Cloud prices are those of a major public provider, used as a market reference; a national provider or a volume contract may have different prices, and the contract amount can replace the estimate in each option.

O custo da governança é estimado opção p: The cost of governance is estimated option by option, with explicit calculations and public parameters, and split into investment (CapEx), operations (OpEx) and usage. This page explains the calculation in two parts: first in plain language, with a fictitious example worked out step by step; then the complete technical model, with the notation, the equations, the parameters and the sources.
Cada opção escolhida no plano tem a sua: Each option chosen in the plan has its own calculation. The sum of the options is the direct cost, and three costs that every public project has are added to it: travel and in-person activities, the institution's indirect costs and the fee of whoever administers the funds. Finally, each amount is split into investment, which creates something that lasts beyond the plan, operations and usage, which is metered cloud consumption. The figure shows this path, from the total down to the source data.
Dois tipos de opção têm contas mais dire: Two types of option have more direct calculations. Full-time staff is the number of people times the monthly cost times the plan's duration. Training is the number of participants times the hours times the hourly cost, estimated at US$ 12 per participant-hour and replaceable by the contract amount.
Quando quem faz o plano não informa as q: When whoever prepares the plan does not enter the quantities, the tool suggests two people per profile for full-time staff, which is the minimum pair to keep the work going during leave and absences, and, for training, the people in the reference teams and staff chosen in the plan, with 20 hours each. These are reference estimates (grade C) and can be changed.
A soma das opções é o custo direto. Sobr: The sum of the options is the direct cost. Added to it are travel and in-person activities (25%, the average share in Global Fund programme budgets), the institution's indirect costs, such as premises, IT, HR and accounting (15%, the limit used by the United States government), and the fee of whoever administers the funds (7%, the fee of UN pooled funds). There is also a question about training people: if whoever prepares the plan answers yes and enters how many people will be trained, the cost people × hours (default 20) × hourly cost (US$ 12) is added, with no percentage on top.
Cada parte de cada opção é investimento: Each part of each option is investment (CapEx), operations (OpEx) or usage, under a simple accounting rule. Investment is the purchase of assets, such as equipment and the infrastructure of an own cloud, and the deployment of systems, platforms, integrations and migrations, which create something that lasts beyond the plan. Usage is metered cloud consumption, such as storage, virtual machines, backup copies and data transfer, which grows with volume. Everything else is operations: the work on regulations, guidelines, supervision, training and staff, licences and contracted services. Additional costs are split in proportion to their base, and the plan's executive summary shows the three types by category and option.
No exemplo, os equipamentos de rede são: In the example, the network equipment is investment ({equip}) and hosting and virtual machines are usage ({hosp} + {vmsV}). The administrative fee is split in proportion to the direct cost, giving {TK} of investment and {TU} of usage, and travel and indirect costs, which apply only to people's work, are operations. Investment: {equip} + {TK} = {K}; usage: {hosp} + {vmsV} + {TU} = {U}; operations: {C} − {K} − {U} = {X}.
O modelo é determinístico e paramétrico:: The model is deterministic and parametric: each cost line is the product of quantities, defined by the reference team or entered in the plan, and unit prices obtained from official statistics or public sources, and additional costs are percentages of bases defined from the lines. Each line is classified as investment (CapEx), operations (OpEx) or usage, and all amounts are rounded to the cent on each line. Below are the notation, the equations, the parameters with value, source and confidence grade, the data handling rules and the reference teams.
Investimento (CapEx), operação (OpEx) e: Investment (CapEx), operations (OpEx) and usage (metered cloud consumption) of the plan, with C = K + X + U

The profile is group 2 (professionals); [[s_o]] is 1 in the AI, data and IT options.
Na formação, [[P_o]] é o número de parti: In training, [[P_o]] is the number of participants, [[h_o]] the hours per participant and [[k]] the cost per participant-hour in dollars. Without entered values, [[P_o]] is the number of people in the reference teams (with added roles) and full-time staff chosen in the plan, and [[h_o]] = 20 (grade C).
O volume [[V]] está em TB e [[\\rho]] é: The volume [[V]] is in TB and [[\rho]] is the price in US$ per GB per month or per machine hour. Storage uses the hot tier price; backup copies (3-2-1 rule) add an infrequently accessed copy and an archive copy; the records archive uses the archive price; and data transfer out of the cloud and data retrieval in a migration use the egress price. These metered consumptions are usage costs, except data retrieval, which is a migration investment. In X-Road, connecting each system ([[n_s]] systems) takes 44 working days, and deploying the central platform 655 days, both at a specialist's daily rate; servers and certificates cost € 6,480 per year per connected system and € 62,160 per year for the central platform, and maintaining the integrations takes 0.1 person per system.
O indicador [[\\delta_Q]] vale 1 quando: The indicator [[\delta_Q]] is 1 when whoever prepares the plan answers that they want to include the training cost; the number of people [[n_Q]] is always entered, and the hours [[h_Q]] (default 20) and the hourly cost can be changed. Training is operations and does not enter the base of travel, overhead or the fee. If the plan also has category 3.2, the people counted here should be different ones.
É investimento ([[K_o]]) a compra de ati: Investment ([[K_o]]) is the purchase of assets and the deployment of systems, platforms, integrations and migration: the sovereign cloud teams (in the contract path), local customisation and migration, the integration of systems and the deployment of X-Road, the investment of the built sovereign cloud, network equipment, technology transfer licensing and data retrieval. Usage ([[U_o]]) is metered cloud consumption: storage, virtual machines (including those of the data catalogue and access control), backup copies, the records archive and data transfer. Regulations, guidelines, supervision, training, staff, licences and services are operations. Additional costs follow the proportion of their base: [[K_P]] in people's work, which has no usage, and [[K_D]] and [[U_D]] in the direct cost.

Custo de formar servidores, gestores ou: Cost of training civil servants, managers or technical teams who will implement the plan: course creation, instructors, room and meals on in-person days, instructors' travel and coordination. It is only included if you answer Yes and enter how many people will be trained.
Two kinds of option have their own calculations. Full-time staff is the number of people times the monthly cost times the length of the plan. Training adds up what a course actually costs: creating the course, the instructors, the room with coffee breaks and lunch on in-person days, the instructors' travel and the coordination, with materials and certification. It blends in-person sessions, taken to the participants' region, with live online sessions.
Criar uma hora de aula presencial leva 3: Creating one hour of in-person teaching takes 38 hours of development, and one hour of live online teaching takes 28, according to the ATD survey (2017); this work is investment, because the course keeps serving after the plan. The room, coffee breaks and lunch follow the average United Kingdom day delegate rate in 2025 (£51), and the instructors' accommodation follows the residential rate (£187), both from the UKCAMS survey and adjusted to the country by the World Bank price level. Classes have 25 people, a teaching day has 7 hours, each class has two instructors, who prepare one hour for each hour of teaching, and coordination adds 15%. The time participants spend on the course is shown separately, outside the total, because it is not new spending.
Quando quem faz o plano não informa as q: When whoever prepares the plan does not enter the quantities, the tool suggests two people per profile for full-time staff, the minimum pair to keep the work going during holidays and absences, and, for training, the people in the reference teams and in the staff chosen in the plan, with 20 hours each, half of them in person. These are reference estimates (grade C) that can be changed.

Instructors' travel: {tau} × 2 × ({dias} × US$ 150 + US$ 80) = {fDes}. Coordination: 15% × ({fIns} + {fSala} + {fDes}) = {fCoo}. Total: {formacao}.
As opções de dados, infraestrutura e ind: Data, infrastructure and technological independence options add, when there is people's work, a reference team and, beyond it, the parts that are purchased: storage, virtual machines, backups, licences and equipment. Cloud consumption is counted by volume, using the public price list of a major provider (storing 1 GB for one month costs about US$ 0.02), and what depends on the supplier, such as network links, commercial licences and equipment, comes in at the value entered. When whoever prepares the plan does not enter the size of the system, the tool suggests 5 systems to integrate, 10 MB per student enrolled in primary and secondary education (World Bank) for stored data and backups, and 4 virtual machines per million students, with a minimum of 4; for the sovereign cloud, it suggests contracting a provider. These are reference estimates (grade C) that can be changed.
A soma das opções é o custo direto. Sobr: The sum of the options is the direct cost. On top of it come travel and in-person activities (25%, the average share in Global Fund programme budgets), the institution's indirect costs, such as space, IT, HR and accounting (15%, the cap used by the United States government), and the fee of whoever administers the funds (7%, the fee of UN pooled funds). There is also a question about training people: if whoever prepares the plan answers yes and enters how many people will be trained, the training cost is added, using the same calculation as category 3.2, with no percentage on top.
As viagens incidem só sobre o trabalho d: Travel applies only to people's work, and indirect costs to that work plus travel; purchases of infrastructure, equipment, licences and cloud services are outside both bases, as is training, which already has its own logistics and coordination, as in the sources, which exclude the purchase of products (Global Fund) and equipment and capital expenditure (United States government). The fee applies to the whole direct cost plus travel. Each has a question in the plan: if there are no in-person activities, if the institution already covers indirect costs or if the agency itself executes the funds, the corresponding percentage is zero.
Cada parte de cada opção é investimento: Each part of each option is investment (CapEx), operation (OpEx) or usage, by a simple accounting rule. Investment is the purchase of assets, such as equipment and the infrastructure of an own cloud, and the deployment of systems, platforms, integrations and migrations, which create something that lasts beyond the plan. Usage is metered cloud consumption, such as storage, virtual machines, backups and data egress, which grows with volume. Operation is everything else: the work on regulations, guidelines, oversight and staff, the delivery of courses, licences and contracted services; in training, only course creation is investment. Additional costs are split in proportion to their base, and the plan's executive summary shows the three types by category and option.
No exemplo, os equipamentos de rede ({eq: In the example, the network equipment ({equip}) and course creation ({fCri}) are investment, and hosting and virtual machines are usage ({hosp} + {vmsV}). The administrative fee is split in proportion to the direct cost, which gives {TK} of investment and {TU} of usage, and travel and indirect costs, which apply only to people's work, are operation. Investment: {equip} + {fCri} + {TK} = {K}; usage: {hosp} + {vmsV} + {TU} = {U}; operation: {C} − {K} − {U} = {X}.

O nível de preços é o fator de PPC do co: The price level is the private consumption PPP conversion factor divided by the official exchange rate (in the euro area, the euro exchange rate). Values outside 0.12 to 1.6, which indicate exchange rate distortion (Iran, Liberia and Zimbabwe), are discarded, and a country without data receives the median of its IMF group (advanced economy 0.778; emerging 0.480; low income 0.344).
As quantidades sugeridas para o pessoal: The suggested quantities for full-time staff (2 per profile), for training (the people in the plan, 20 hours each, half in person) and for the size of the challenge 2 systems do not come from an external source: they are tool estimates so that no line is left without a value, and should be replaced by the quantities of the real plan.
Na formação, a criação do curso pesa mai: In training, course creation weighs more when few people are trained: with one class, it is most of the cost; with many, delivery dominates. As a market reference, IAPP's official AI governance training costs US$ 1,195 for 13 online hours, about US$ 92 per hour per person.
